subtopics.title: Newton's Laws and Momentum — the Mechanics Core

questions.question: Newton's first law says a body keeps its state of rest or constant velocity unless:
options: A non-zero net force acts on it

questions.question: An 8 kg crate pulled by 100 N against 28 N of friction accelerates at:
options: 9 m·s⁻² — net force 72 N over 8 kg

questions.question: A 0,4 kg ball hits a wall at 12 m·s⁻¹ and rebounds at 9 m·s⁻¹ (towards the wall positive). Its change in momentum is:
options: −8,4 kg·m·s⁻¹ — the rebound velocity enters as negative

questions.question: A 3 kg trolley at 4 m·s⁻¹ couples with a stationary 1 kg trolley. KE goes from 24 J to 18 J, so the collision is:
options: Inelastic — kinetic energy decreased, shown by calculation

subtopics.title: Projectile Motion, Work, Energy and Power

questions.question: At the very top of a vertical throw:
options: v = 0 but a is still 9,8 m·s⁻² downward
v and a are both zero

questions.question: A ball thrown up at 24,5 m·s⁻¹ reaches a maximum height of:
A 2 kg box slides down a rough 4 m ramp, arriving at 7 m·s⁻¹. The friction work is:
options: −29,4 J — the gap between 49 J gained and 78,4 J surrendered

questions.question: A pump raises 150 kg of water through 20 m at constant speed in 14 s. Its power is:
Charges of 4 µC and 2 µC sit 0,2 m apart. The electrostatic force between them is:
The electric field of a NEGATIVE point charge points:
options: In a circle around the charge
Nowhere — negative charges have no field

questions.question: A 12 V battery with r = 0,5 Ω drives 3 A. Its terminal voltage is:
options: 10,5 V — emf minus the lost volts, 3 × 0,5

questions.question: With 6 V across two parallel 4 Ω branches, the audit that closes the books is:
options: The emf equalling the branch voltage

questions.question: A DC generator differs from an AC generator because it uses:
options: A split-ring commutator, reversing connections every half turn

questions.question: The rms potential difference is defined as:
options: The peak voltage divided by two
The AC potential difference dissipating the same energy as an equivalent DC potential difference
The average of the sine wave

questions.question: Light of frequency 7,5 × 10¹⁴ Hz carries photons of energy:
Increasing the INTENSITY of light on a metal surface:
options: Raises each electron's maximum kinetic energy
Ejects more electrons per second, each with unchanged maximum kinetic energy

subtopics.title: The Syllabus as a Map of Three Territories

questions.question: The broadest territory of the year's physics — where preparation pays the highest rent — is:
The cheapest marks in any physics question are usually:
The habit that straightens most wandering solutions is:
options: Naming the territory and the equation before touching the calculator

questions.question: A question about forces or acceleration at one instant calls for:
options: The force story — free-body diagram, then F_net = ma

questions.question: A question connecting a height to a speed, skipping the in-between, calls for:
options: The energy budget — the books must balance in joules

questions.question: In the ramp example, friction's cut of the energy budget showed up as:
options: −29,4 J — the gap between height money spent and speed banked

questions.question: The three ledgers of mechanics, each with one rule, are:
options: Net force for instants, energy for journeys, momentum for crashes

subtopics.title: The Final Sweep — Symbols, Signs and the Classic Traps

questions.question: At the top of a vertical throw, the classic trap is believing:
options: The acceleration is zero there — it is still 9,8 m·s⁻² downward

questions.question: A voltmeter across a battery's terminals reads the full emf only when:
options: No current flows — under load it drops by the lost volts, I times r

questions.question: Brighter light on a metal surface means:
options: More electrons per second, never faster ones

questions.question: A finished vector answer must state:
options: Both magnitude and direction — 168 N away from the wall, not just 168 N
